description:
Legal / topsheet tracker. Built the live legal source for the topsheet tracker by integrating legal contract data via a Model Context Protocol (MCP) endpoint into internal TPM status tooling. Contract requests are now tracked alongside software and hardware issues in one place.

Machine fleet health. Built an event-driven n8n workflow tracking datacenter host uptime, and Looker Studio dashboards giving executives real-time visibility into machine-fleet allocation. The same pipelines, built with Google Apps Script, the Jira API, and Looker Studio, also give executives real-time visibility into software epics.

Models in training and bring-up. Built an n8n workflow tracking all models in training and bring-up. It gives senior AI software engineers and TPMs a shared progress view of every model in flight.
title: Tenstorrent — Agentic TPM Internship

description: Can a sneaker's StockX resale premium be predicted from product and market features? 327 SKUs and 1,635 sneaker-size observations from KicksDB (Jan–May 2026) via the StockX Pricing Data API. Median premium was 0.92; grouped cross-validation R² was near zero (best sensitivity model, with retail price, mean CV R² = 0.049), and a classifier for beating retail reached held-out ROC-AUC 0.646. Product features alone only weakly predict premium — an honest, useful result.
title: Sneaker Resale Premium on StockX

description: Predict whether a Spotify track is explicit from its audio features. 18,000 tracks across five genre groups (urban, metal, electronic, acoustic, latin). A Random Forest (n_estimators=200, max_depth=20) reached test F1 ~0.64, up from a logistic-regression baseline of 0.24. By Canyon Crutchfield and Nate McNeill.
title: Spotify Explicitness Classifier

description: Interactive Mapbox + D3 map of Boston and Cambridge Bluebikes stations. Boston and Cambridge bike-lane GeoJSON, March 2024 trip data, a time slider, and station circles sized by total traffic and coloured by departure/arrival flow. Live demo: ctcrutchfield-stack.github.io/bikewatching.
title: Bikewatching — Boston Bluebikes Geospatial Map

description: DSC Project 3. Interactive D3 map of NOAA GOES-18 satellite thermal detections across California, July 24–August 6, 2024, with hourly time scrubbing, water-vapour contours, and Fire Radiative Power (MW) for the Park Fire region. Canyon cleaned the satellite data in Python and converted fire detections to geographic coordinates. Live demo: ctcrutchfield-stack.github.io/dsc-project-3.
title: California Wildfire Thermal Anomaly Tracker

description: Predictive models using gradient descent and regression techniques to evaluate and forecast MLB team performance.
title: MLB Regular-Season Performance Model

description: A visual that compares the food processing scores of various corporations, highlighting their impact on public health and nutrition.
title: Food Processing Scores by Corporation

description: Proposition: civilian police complaints against the NYPD are mainly violent and abusive. NLP analysis of pro- and anti-stance TikTok videos and civilian complaint data, testing whether the majority of complaints are violent and abusive. Python, pandas, matplotlib, seaborn.
title: Pro/Anti-Stance NYPD Proposition: Identifying the Narrative
